hypothesis: The analytic pullback reduced fixed-state step cost16-18%; check whether full training retains physical quality and wall-time benefit despite FP32 trajectory changes.
fixed_settings: Current Torch2.1/cu118 RTX4070Ti, FP32 TF32off, hidden32x32x32, hard_initial_robin, recursive, auto background, backward parameters. Same polynomial encoding; only eager versus neumann_analytic execution differs within each pair. Fresh Python process per trial, balanced order, shared GPU lock. Independent quality evaluation always eager/general/ordinary-autograd.
measurements: Global/final/worst-time L2, independent physical PDE residual, initial/face temperature errors, per-face Neumann operator, work counters, training/process/prediction time, allocated/reserved memory, trainable parameter count, initial/objective hashes. Time-to-quality requires two adjacent successes; no interpolation or teacher in training.
storage: Only final rows, control snapshots and a concise result report go into Git. Raw repeated temporal profiles remain in numerical-reports on Windows. Mathematical derivations stay complete.
interpretation: Keep failed/censored trials. Require two adjacent successful snapshots. Compare reported intervals, never interpolated exact crossing times. Fixed step budget is not equal wall time; crossing intervals test the time-to-quality hypothesis. No default promotion and no dependency upgrades.
training_code_revision: explicit analytic executor; exact source revision recorded by worker
informed_by: pullback006 fixed-state profile and tolerance005; exploratory follow-up
baseline_study: fresh eager control with identical seed/config/weights shape/points in every pair

gates.physical: finite, initial RMS<=1e-6 and face operator max<=1e-5
gates.quality: each candidate final global/final/PDE/mode metric <=max(1.5*paired eager, corresponding registered strict threshold); preserve any eager confirmed quality crossing in candidate budget
gates.timing: median paired full training ratio<=0.95 percase and worst<=1.10; report time-to-quality intervals separately
gates.scope: No automatic default promotion; independent evaluator uses ordinary autograd. Record all failures and closure counts.
